name: Alex
text: I am actually from a pretty small city, you know.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: It is not one of those huge megacities, but it has got everything I need.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: The food is amazing, especially the street food near my old school.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And honestly, the pace of life there is so much slower, in a good way.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Whenever I go back, I just feel this sense of relief, like time slows down a little.
